sentences.en: The doors were locked and we couldn't get in anyhow.
sentences.zh: 门被锁上了，我们无论如何也进不去。

sentences.en: After I locked all the doors, I went to bed.
sentences.zh: 我把所有的门都锁了之后才去睡觉。

sentences.en: Really? I had locked it up before I went out.
sentences.zh: 真的吗？我出去之前已经把门锁好了。

senses.zh: 锁 - 水闸, 船闸 - 刹车 - (头发的)一绺 -
